sessions.title: Session 1: Foundations & Architecture of Claude Code
sessions.description: Introduction to Claude Code, foundational concepts, CLI setup, and architecture.

sessions.title: Session 2: CLI Workflows & Context Engineering
sessions.description: Module 2 covering deep CLI interaction patterns, prompt engineering, and context management.

sessions.title: Session 3: Agentic Tool Use & Multi-File Refactoring
sessions.description: Module 3 exploring tool execution, agentic refactoring, and multi-file workflows.

sessions.title: Session 4: Production Audits & Testing Automation
sessions.description: Deep-dive into accessibility audits, multi-task verification, and testing automation.

sessions.title: Session 5: Advanced Systems & Technical Deep Dive
sessions.description: Advanced technical deep-dive into custom extensions, tool design, and production agent patterns.
